city.Saudi Arabia.description: Saudi Arabia is a huge desert kingdom in the Middle East. It holds Islam's holiest cities, Mecca and Medina, the vast sandy Empty Quarter, and ancient tombs carved into rose-colored rock at Hegra.
city.Saudi Arabia.landmark: grand Nabatean tomb carved into a rose-colored sandstone outcrop at Hegra
city.Saudi Arabia.greeting: In Arabic, a warm hello is “As-salamu alaykum” (as-sa-LAM-oo a-LAY-kum).

city.South Korea.description: South Korea sits on a peninsula in East Asia. It is famous worldwide for its K-pop music and TV dramas, blazing-fast internet, grand palaces in Seoul, and the volcanic island of Jeju.

city.Syria.description: Syria is an ancient country in the Middle East. Its capital, Damascus, is one of the oldest cities on Earth, and the land is dotted with desert ruins like Palmyra and mighty Crusader castles.

city.Tajikistan.description: Tajikistan is a small, mountainous country in Central Asia. Almost the whole land is covered by towering peaks, including the icy Pamir Mountains, nicknamed the "Roof of the World."

city.Timor-Leste.description: This young country shares an island with Indonesia in Southeast Asia. It became fully independent in 2002, grows prized highland coffee, and its warm seas are packed with colorful fish and coral.
